reasons: Cited text supports the compliant classification: §14.1 confirms Customer ownership of Customer Data and independently developed IP with only a limited processing right to Vendor; §14.2 vests Deliverables in Customer with an express Vendor assignment and personnel/further-assurance obligations; §14.3 plus §13.2 give a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded Vendor Technology; §14.4 bars unagreed joint ownership and limits feedback use.
No walk-away trigger present — no assignment of Customer IP or Customer Data to Vendor, and no unrestricted joint ownership; deterministic check confirms no residual assignment language.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the redline output is identical to the original paragraphs.

Minor shortfalls (ownership conditioned on payment of Fees; sublicence expressed as contractor support rather than a general sublicence) are correctly noted in the rationale rather than flagged as deviations, per the playbook's classification rules.
